question: According to the author, sustainable impact occurs when microfinance is combined with:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Microfinance institutions (MFIs) provide small loans and financial education to underserved populations in rural areas.
 
• MFIs empower entrepreneurs, often women, to start or grow microenterprises such as poultry farming, handloom weaving, and retail outlets.
 
• Sustainable economic impact occurs when microfinance is combined with additional support mechanisms like market linkages, ensuring borrowers have guaranteed buyers for their products.
 
• Excessive interest rates or short loan tenures alone do not guarantee sustainable growth and may lead to over-indebtedness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** High interest rates – (उच्च ब्याज दरें) Excessive rates can lead to over-indebtedness, not sustainable growth.
 
• **Option 3:** Shorter loan tenures – (छोटे ऋण अवधि) May increase repayment pressure without supporting long-term economic stability.
 
• **Option 4:** Government bailouts – (सरकारी सहायता) Not mentioned in the passage as a factor for sustainable microfinance impact.
